title: 第一卷 第25章 睡他的床
content_zh:
童喻也识趣，重新拉拢浴袍，系上腰带。

    霍放走到门口，按了可视门禁。

    “霍放，开门。”

    童喻听到这个声音，眉头轻蹙了一下。

    是赵亦可。

    “稍等。”没有一丝迟疑，霍放就远程开门了。

    他再折回来，童喻就知道，她该走了。

    她得赶紧去穿好衣服，在赵亦可到达之前离开。

    至少，得跟她错开。

    “你去哪？”霍放看到童喻去了洗手间。

    “我换衣服。”童喻说：“赵小姐站在门口之前，我会离开。”

    霍放盯着她，桃花眼里带着一抹戏笑，“你觉得她快，还是你快？”

    童喻不知道。

    “你为什么怕她看见你？”霍放问。

    童喻也不是怕赵亦可看到自己，就是觉得自己穿成这样在他家里，不太好。

    即便赵亦可是他妹妹，她还是能避开就避开。

    “来不及了。”霍放走过去，拉着她的手，带着她往里面走，推开一扇隐形门，“先去休息。”

    童喻诧异。

    霍放松开她的手，挑眉，“事还没完。好好休息，养足精神。”

    童喻明白他的意思了。

    她垂眸低头看自己的脚，“好。”

    霍放伸手抚摸着她的脸，“怎么了？失落？”

    童喻没有失落。

    脸贴着他温热的掌心，“我在这里，真的不会不方便吗？”

    “他们在，才不方便。”霍放的手绕到她的后颈，轻轻捏住，凑近她的脸，用力地吸着她身上的味道，明明用着自己的沐浴露，就是觉得她身上的味道更好闻一些。

    他贪婪地贴着她的耳边，气息喷洒在她的颈窝，“好好睡觉。”

    童喻浑身酥麻，还是很稳定，“嗯。”

    霍放恋恋不舍地放开她。

    正好，门铃声也响了。

    霍放果断转身，出去的时候把门给关上了。

    童喻狠吸了一口气，才转身打量着这间卧室。

    看得出来，这是主卧室。

    里面，有住过的痕迹。
content_en:
Tong Yu also realized what was going on, so he pulled the bathrobe back together and tied the belt.

    Huo Fang walked to the door and pressed the video access control.

    "Huo Fang, open the door."

    When Tong Yu heard this voice, he frowned slightly.

    It's Zhao Yike.

    "Wait a moment." Without any hesitation, Huo Fang opened the door remotely.

    When he came back again, Tong Yu knew that it was time for her to leave.

    She had to get dressed quickly and leave before Zhao Yike arrived.

    At least, keep away from her.

    "Where are you going?" Huo Fang saw Tong Yu going to the bathroom.

    "I'll change clothes." Tong Yu said, "I will leave before Miss Zhao stands at the door."

    Huo Fang stared at her, with a hint of amusement in his peach blossom eyes, "Do you think she is faster, or you?"

    Tong Yu doesn't know.

    "Why are you afraid that she will see you?" Huo Fang asked.

    Tong Yu was not afraid that Zhao Yike would see him, but he just felt that it was not good for him to be in his house dressed like this.

    Even though Zhao Yi was his sister, she would still avoid it if she could.

    "It's too late." Huo Fang walked over, took her hand, led her inside, and opened an invisible door, "Go and rest first."

    Tong Yu was surprised.

    Huo Song relaxed her hand and raised his eyebrows, "It's not over yet. Have a good rest and refresh yourself."

    Tong Yu understood what he meant.

    She lowered her eyes and looked down at her feet, "Okay."

    Huo Fang reached out and touched her face, "What's wrong? Lost?"

    Tong Yu was not disappointed.

    She pressed her face against his warm palm, "Isn't it really inconvenient for me to be here?"

    "It's inconvenient for them to be here." Huo Fang put his hand around the back of her neck, pinched it gently, and got close to her face, inhaling the scent of her body vigorously. He was obviously using his own shower gel, but he felt that her body smelled better.

    He hungrily pressed against her ear, his breath spraying on her neck, "Sleep well."

    Tong Yu felt numb all over, but still very stable, "Yeah."

    Huo Fang reluctantly let her go.

    Just in time, the doorbell rang too.

    Huo Fang turned around decisively and closed the door when he went out.

    Tong Yu took a deep breath before turning around and looking at the bedroom.

    It can be seen that this is the master bedroom.

    Inside, there are traces of living there.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 25 Sleeping in his bed
